name: Canada – Ontario
title: The Ontario Year-Wheel
tagline: What's growing in Ontario, month by month.
attribution: Months are the Foodland Ontario Availability Guide: when that Ontario-grown crop is available to buy, including storage and greenhouse. Contains information licensed under the Open Government Licence – Ontario. This is Ontario, not a Canada-wide calendar, and it is not a harvest-date chart.
thin_sheet: The guide only has the month grid for this one, so that's all we show.

copy.edge_why: The Foodland guide is available or not; it has no edge level.
copy.no_peak: No peak level in this guide
copy.hint: Tap a month on the wheel, or use the ← → keys.
